welcome.title: Welcome to FadeUp
welcome.subtitle: Three questions to personalise what you'll see. You can skip them all.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.why: Useful when you book — never shown publicly.

gender.title: You are… ?
gender.why: Optional. Only used to surface barbershops or mixed salons. This answer stays on your device.

frequency.title: How often do you get a haircut?
frequency.why: So we can, later on, remind you to book at the right time.

feed.title: The feed is coming
feed.body: Posts from the barbers you follow and local discovery arrive in the next release (M1b).

bookings.title: Your bookings are coming
bookings.body: Tracking your bookings and your queue spot arrives in the next release (M1b).

account.title: Your account is coming
account.body: Sign-in, your Fade Passport and your preferences arrive in the next release (M1b).

booking.title: Booking is coming
booking.body: The booking flow arrives in the next release of the app (M1b). The profile stays whole: follow this professional or browse their work in the meantime.

queue.title: The queue is coming
queue.body: Joining and tracking a live queue arrives in the next release of the app (M1b).

search.cityHint: Search by city, or use “Near me”.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't match any screen.

connect.title: Sign-in is coming
connect.body: Creating an account and following your barbers arrives in the next release (M1b). Everything stays freely browsable in the meantime.
